title: Each moved customer gets a note naming the old term, new term and user
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves the only customer on a term of its own to Net 45, and you check the customer's notes.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, {Customer-A}, with a $0.00 limit.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-10 N20 and {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-10 Solo.
  • Your user name is {User-A}.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-10 Admin.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  6. Click the "Notes" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button reads "Move 1 Customer".
  • Step 4: a green success toast shows.
  • Step 5: the page opens.
  • Step 6: a new note, authored by {User-A}, reads "Credit term changed from {Term-A} to Net 45 by {User-A} (Move Customers)." with nothing about the credit limit after it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R11: “Each moved customer gets a note on its Notes, authored by the user who moved it, reading "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." A customer moved from a blank term reads "from COD".”
  • S4-R20: “When a move changes a customer's limit (a limit above $0 set to $0), that customer's note (S4-R11) ends with "Credit limit {old limit} → $0." A customer whose limit was already $0 or blank gets the S4-R11 note without it.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Note on each moved customer | "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." followed by "Credit limit {old limit} → $0." when the move changed the limit | Note on the customer's Notes”
  • Key Decisions: “Every change on the Credit Terms page is recorded in an organization-wide Credit Terms Log (Story 12: Credit Terms audit log), and every customer moved by Move Customers also gets a note naming the old term, the new term and the user.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Moved"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-05-moved.png

The design's own words:

  • “Each moved customer gets a note on its Notes, by the user who moved it: "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." When its limit went from above $0 to $0, the note ends with "Credit limit {old limit} → $0." (S4-R11, S4-R20).”
